WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
), shares_vs_average AS (
    SELECT region, client_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM region_shares
)
SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_client_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_average
FROM shares_vs_average
WHERE share > average_share;
